stories.title: Paraurethral Cyst in Burkina Faso: A Case Report
stories.description: Paraurethral cyst is an uncommon pathology of the female lower urinary tract. It may remain asymptomatic or present with bothersome symptoms such as dysuria, recurrent urinary tract infections, or local discomfort. We report the rare case of a young virgin woman presenting with a symptomatic paraurethral cyst, revealed by voiding difficulties. Surgical management was performed, consisting of complete cystectomy associated with hymeneal repair, which preserved anatomical integrity and functional outcomes. Postoperative evolution was favorable, with resolution of symptoms and no recurrence observed. This case highlights the importance of early diagnosis and tailored surgical.

stories.title: Neighborhood multiple topological indices of
stories.description: First-principles modelling of $$\beta _{12}$$-borophene mechanical properties is computationally demanding, and experimental characterisation is time-intensive. This study derives nine neighbourhood multiple degree-based topological indices (TIs) using the M-polynomial approach and examines their relationships with Young’s modulus (E), Shear modulus (G), and ​Poisson’s ratio ($$\nu$$). Fourteen $$\beta _{12}$$-borophene structures are analysed using raw and vertex-normalised TIs across three regression models: a size-only baseline, a TI-only model, and a combined TI+Size model. The convergence of the normalised indices is examined using two-dimensional exponential fits. The size-only baseline achieves $$R^{2}=0.9976$$, 0.9970, and 0.9991 for E, G, and $$\nu$$, with LOOCV $$Q^{2}=0.9967$$, 0.9959, and 0.9988. Among the normalised TI-only models, $$\Gamma _{N_M}M_2^{nm}(\mathfrak {G})$$ yields the highest $$R^{2}=0.6451$$, 0.7100, and 0.7009. Combining normalised TIs with sheet size raises $$R^{2}$$ by at most 0.0018, 0.0016, and 0.0005; the corresponding raw-TI gains are 0.0015, 0.0009, and 0.0003. Neither set improves LOOCV performance consistently. The convergence fits yield $$R^{2}$$ between 0.7977 and 0.9976, with seven of the nine exceeding 0.99. Sheet size is therefore the dominant predictor, with the TIs providing only limited additional explanatory information. Because the data are synthetic and limited to fourteen structures, independent validation against first-principles or experimental values is required before broader application.
